FULL TEXT:
GUJARAT STATE LEGAL SERVIES AUTHORITY
3rd Floor, GSLSA Building, Near Gujarat High Court Post Office,
Gujarat High Court Campus, Sola, Ahmedabad.
NOTICE
GSLSA / 452 /2024
As directed by the Hon’ble High Court Mediation Committee
this Authority is going to undertake the process to revise the Panel
of Mediators for High Court Mediation Centre. Therefore,
applications are invited from the competent and interested
Advocates. If the retired Judicial Officers want to be empanelled,
they can directly send their application to the Member Secretary,
Gujarat State Legal Services Authority, Ahmedabad.
1. Eligibility: - The Following person can apply for the same.
A) Advocates of Hon’ble High Court who has experience of at
least 10 years of advocacy.
B) Retired District & Sessions Judge/ Retired Additional
District Judge / Retried Civil Judge.
C) Retired Senior Administrative Officer.
D) Other Professionals or Specialists having minimum 15
years experience.
E) Those Advocates/Retired Judicial Officers or other
Professionals who have taken 40 hours Mediation Training
led by Mediation and Conciliation Project
Committee(MCPC), New Delhi.
2. Place and the last date of submission of Application: The
candidate holding eligibility may, in the prescribed format,
submit their application in the office of the “Gujarat High
Court Mediation Centre” 2nd Floor, GSLSA Building, Near
Gujarat High Court Post Office, Gujarat High Court Campus,
Sola, Ahmedabad-380060 or may send it through post to the
aforesaid address. The Format of the application can be
downloaded from the website of the Gujrat State Legal
Services Authority (https://gslsa.gujarat.gov.in/).
The application should reach to the above office on or
before 28.03.2024, by 5.00pm. latest. The applications
submitted thereafter will not be considered.
3. Attachment of self-attested copy of the documents with
the application form: With the application form, self-
certified copy of all the documents in support of qualifications
and experience should be included.
4. Selection of Panel: The applications received within
prescribed time will be verified and the procedure as may be
directed by the High Court Mediation Committee will be
adopted.
5. For preparation of Panel of Mediators, as far as possible, the
provisions of the Mediation Rules, 2015, prepared by MCPC
will be complied with.
6. Decision of the High Court Mediation Committee for
preparation of Panel of Mediators and to get them trained
form MCPC, New Delhi will be considered as final decision.
7. Training: The selected Mediators have to undergo
compulsory 40 hours Mediation Training imparted by the
trainers of MCPC as per the curriculum laid down in
Mediation Training Manual or as directed by MCPC.
8. The Mediator appointed shall normally be on the Panel for a
period of 3years from the date of appointment and further
extension of the tenure shall be at the discretion of High
Court Mediation Committee.
9. Honorarium: As per the prevailing rules of
MCPC/NALSA/Gujarat State Legal Services Authority, the
prescribed honorarium will be paid, from time to time, on
providing theirs services in the form of Mediator.
Date: 14.03.2024.
Sd/-
